app.title: VisaCRM
auth.noRegistration: Accounts are created by the platform admin. If you forgot your password, contact them.
auth.changePasswordForced: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own to open the workspace.
auth.changePasswordHint: After the change you will need to sign in again on other devices.
nav.label: Main menu
cabinet.comingText: Key figures, clients, cases and the “Needs attention” list will appear here. For now you can change your password and language in the menu.
admin.specialistsSubtitle: Visa specialist accounts on the platform
admin.newSpecialistHint: The system issues a temporary password. The specialist replaces it on first sign-in.
admin.confirmBlock: Block {{email}}? The specialist and their employees will be signed out at once.
admin.confirmReset: Issue a new temporary password to {{email}}? The old one stops working and two-factor sign-in is reset — the specialist sets it up again.
admin.issuedText: Give the password for {{email}} in person or via a messenger.
admin.issuedWarning: The password is shown only once. If it gets lost, issue a new one.
errors.account_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.account_disabled: This account is blocked. Contact the administrator.
errors.not_authenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.
errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least {{count}} characters long.
errors.email_taken: This email is already in use.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
twoFactor.codeHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for VisaCRM.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved during setup. Each code works once.
twoFactor.useRecovery: No access to the app? Use a recovery code
twoFactor.useApp: Use a code from the app
twoFactor.setupIntro: To protect client data, sign-in is confirmed with a code from an app on your phone. Setup takes a minute.
twoFactor.stepInstall: Install an authenticator app: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or another.
twoFactor.stepScan: In the app, add an account and scan the QR code.
twoFactor.stepCode: Enter the 6-digit code from the app
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter the key manually:
twoFactor.codesIntro: If you lose your phone, sign in with one of these codes. Each works once. Keep them somewhere safe — they won't be shown again.
errors.login_expired: Time to enter the code has run out. Please sign in again.
errors.two_factor_setup_not_started: Reload the page and scan the QR code again.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitleAdmin: All platform events. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.
audit.subtitleWorkspace: Sign-ins and changes in your workspace, including the administrator's actions. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.
admin.modulesHint: The specialist sees and uses only the modules turned on here and gives employees modules from this list. Modules of later stages start working once they are built.
employees.title: Employees
employees.subtitle: Assistants you open part of the workspace to. Each sees only the sections given to them.
employees.newHint: The system issues a temporary password. The employee replaces it on first sign-in.
employees.modulesHint: You can give only the sections enabled for you.
employees.confirmBlock: Block {{email}}? The employee is signed out at once.
employees.confirmReset: Issue a new temporary password to {{email}}? The old one stops working and two-factor sign-in is reset.
errors.module_not_available: This section is not enabled for you, so it cannot be given to an employee.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Style and language change only for your account.
settings.themeHint: The style is saved in your account and opens on all your devices.
theme.blue.name: Business blue
theme.blue.about: Light cards and a dark menu.
theme.dark.name: Dark
theme.dark.about: Dark background and a mint accent, easier on the eyes at night.
theme.warm.name: Warm
theme.warm.about: Warm tones, round buttons, serif headings.
theme.minimal.name: Minimal
theme.minimal.about: White background, black accent, thin lines.
reference.title: Countries and appointment rules
reference.subtitleAdmin: The platform's shared reference: how to get an appointment for each country from a submission country. Specialists see it read-only.
reference.noRules: No rules for this submission country yet.
reference.verifiedLabel: Verified by the operator's catalogue or a specialist
reference.citiesHint: Each city has its own queue. Switch off a city that no longer accepts applications — cases that use it keep it.
reference.countriesHint: Visa countries and submission countries. A switched-off country disappears from specialists' lists but stays in old cases.
reference.codeHint: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 code, for example PL or GB.
reference.operatorCodeHint: System code: lowercase Latin letters, digits and _, for example vfs. It cannot be changed later.
reference.subtitleWorkspace: How to book a client for each country: booking type, operator, number at the visa center, appeals and submission cities.
reference.workspaceHint: The platform administrator keeps this reference. If something is out of date, let them know.
errors.country_code_taken: A country with this code already exists.
errors.operator_code_taken: An operator with this code already exists.
errors.rule_exists: A rule for this pair of countries already exists.
errors.window_days_required: For an application with a window, enter the window in days.
dict.title: Lists
dict.subtitle: Your lists for client files and cases: visa purposes, channels, partners, registrars, prepayments, currencies.
dict.purposesHint: Each purpose has its own queue at the visa center. Switch off a purpose you no longer use — old cases keep it.
dict.channelsHint: Where clients come from: analytics counts the funnel and profit per channel.
dict.name: Name
dict.partnersHint: People who bring clients for a fee. Their terms are filled into a case by country and can be changed there.
dict.terms.title: Terms
dict.termsHint: The «All countries» row applies when a country has no terms of its own. A percent is of the whole service price, with no deductions. «Not tracked» means no payout is computed or stored.
dict.registrarsHint: People who put clients in a queue for a fee. The fee depends on the country, visa purpose and hall; a case takes it from the price list.
dict.pricesHint: One fee per country, visa purpose and hall. «Any purpose» applies when a purpose has no fee of its own.
dict.prepaymentsHint: A fixed prepayment per country and visa purpose, in {{currency}}. It is filled into a case's finances and can be changed there.
dict.source.nbrb: National Bank of Belarus on the payment date (editable in a payment)
dict.moneyAdminHint: The accounting currency and the tax rate are set by the platform administrator.
errors.duplicate_entry: The list repeats a row — keep one.
contacts.title: Clients
contacts.subtitle: Everyone who has contacted you: a client file outlives any case.
contacts.empty: No clients yet. Add the first one.
contacts.fullNameLatinHint: As in the passport — for forms.
contacts.phoneHint: With the country code, for example +375 29 123-45-67. The system does not allow a second file with the same phone.
contacts.telegramHint: Username without @ or the name in Telegram.
contacts.messengerContact: Number or username in the messenger
contacts.filesLater: Consent and contract files can be attached once file storage is connected.
contacts.noRelations: No links yet: family, who brought whom.
contacts.relationLabel: Who they are to this client
contacts.reverseLabel: Who this client is to them
contacts.notePlaceholder: What you discussed, what was decided, what to do next
contacts.confirmDeleteNote: Delete the note? It cannot be restored.
errors.phone_taken: A client with this phone already exists.
errors.self_link: A client cannot be linked to themselves.
reference.passportRuleValue: issued ≤ {{years}} years ago, +{{months}} months after the trip
reference.passportHint: Passport rules for the questionnaire check. Schengen: issued within the last 10 years and valid 3 more months after departure. Empty — the rule is not checked.
contacts.hint.passport_expired: The passport has expired — a new one is needed.
contacts.hint.passport_too_old: {{country}}: the passport was issued too long before the trip.
contacts.hint.passport_expires_too_soon: {{country}}: the passport expires sooner than required after the trip.
contacts.hint.refusal_before: {{country}}: there was a refusal for this country before — keep it in mind.
contacts.hint.invitation_relatives: {{country}}: relatives or friends live there — a visa by invitation is possible.
contacts.hint.invitation_humanitarian: {{country}}: a childhood humanitarian trip — a visa by invitation is possible.
contacts.feeHint: The consultation fee counts towards the price whenever the client comes back.
contacts.casesLater: The «Create case» button comes with cases (backlog 1.4).
errors.currency_not_accepted: This currency is not turned on in Lists → Currencies and tax.
